title: ScaleBrain: A Scale-Consistent Framework for EEG Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.14035v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation models pre-trained on large unlabeled electroencephalography (EEG) corpora have emerged as a transformative paradigm for Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) applications. Recent EEG foundation models have shown that multi-scale representations derived from fixed-length patches can improve EEG representation learning. Existing frameworks commonly construct temporal scales through feature-level operations. However, these operations leave the correspondence between learned features and scale-specific characteristics of the original EEG signals implicit. Moreover, when the self-supervised objective is not aligned with the multi-scale input representations, information at some temporal scales may receive insufficient supervision during pre-training. In light of this, we propose ScaleBrain, a scale-consistent pre-training framework that explicitly coordinates multi-scale representations of EEG from both the model input and optimization o

translated_title: ScaleBrain：面向脑电图基础模型的尺度一致性框架
translated_abstract: 在大规模无标注脑电图（EEG）语料上预训练的基础模型，已成为脑机接口（BCI）应用的一种变革性范式。近期的EEG基础模型表明，从固定长度片段中提取的多尺度表示能够改善EEG的表示学习。现有框架通常通过特征层面的操作来构建时间尺度，然而这些操作使得学习到的特征与原始EEG信号尺度特定特性之间的对应关系变得隐式。此外，当自监督目标与多尺度输入表示不一致时，某些时间尺度的信息在预训练过程中可能得不到充分的监督。有鉴于此，我们提出了ScaleBrain，一个尺度一致的预训练框架，从模型输入和优化目标两个层面显式协调EEG的多尺度表示……
tldr: 提出了ScaleBrain——一个尺度一致的EEG基础模型预训练框架，通过在模型输入与优化目标两个层面显式协调多尺度表示，解决了现有方法中特征与原始信号尺度特性对应关系隐式、部分时间尺度监督不足的问题。
en_tdlr: ScaleBrain is a scale-consistent pre-training framework for EEG foundation models that explicitly coordinates multi-scale EEG representations at both the model input and optimization levels, addressing the implicit feature-to-scale correspondence and insufficient supervision at certain temporal scales in existing methods.
